# identity-public.extra.txt — the RED-control fixture for the drift check.
#
# Identical to identity-public.txt except identity has opened ONE more public
# route (POST /v1/password-resets/expired-purge — invented for this fixture;
# it names no real operation). The drift check run against THIS file must
# report exactly that route as missing from gateway, and fail. A check that
# passes because it read only gateway's own list cannot do that, which is why
# this fixture exists: it proves the comparison reads the declaration.
POST /v1/agents
GET /v1/agents/claim/{token}
GET /v1/auth/oauth/{provider}
GET /v1/auth/oauth/{provider}/callback
POST /v1/email-changes/current-address
POST /v1/email-changes/new-address
POST /v1/email-verifications
POST /v1/email-verifications/confirm
POST /v1/password-resets
POST /v1/password-resets/confirm
POST /v1/password-resets/expired-purge
POST /v1/session
POST /v1/session-links/redeem
POST /v1/session/mfa
POST /v1/signup-timestamp
POST /v1/users
